subject: "Persistent" collapsing of LaTeX code in RStudio

messages.author: 985e455b8390aae3
messages.subject: "Persistent" collapsing of LaTeX code in RStudio
parts:
I'm working on a very long document, and it helps me to collapse away the portions I'm not working on, preferable section-by section.

Within the code chunks I can describe a fold by "----", and can "Collapse All" of the chunks.  However, within the LaTeX portion of the .Rnw file, I can only highlight sections and Alt+L to collapse, but these folds only exist until I unfold them and disappear.  Also, when I close a file with these temporary folds, they disappear when I reopen the file.

Is there a way I can permanently add folds to the LaTeX portion of the document that are affected by the "Collapse All" command?

Thanks.
